headline: Profit rebounds as prior-year impairment charge fades
summary_short: Donaldson's net sales rose 5.8% y/y to $995.1M and net earnings more than doubled to $118.1M (diluted EPS $1.00 vs $0.48) as operating income jumped to $155.3M from $87.4M, mainly because last year's quarter absorbed a $62.0M intangible impairment that didn't recur.
summary_long: Net sales rose 5.8% y/y to $995.1M: Mobile Solutions +8.1% (Aftermarket demand), Life Sciences +12.7% (Food & Beverage, Disk Drive), plus $25.4M favorable FX, partly offset by Industrial Solutions -0.6% (Aerospace & Defense supply-chain constraints). Gross margin fell to 33.5% from 34.2% on $9.1M of costs tied to relocating Power Generation production, partly offset by pricing gains. Operating income rose to $155.3M from $87.4M and net earnings to $118.1M from $57.8M, mainly because last year's quarter carried a $62.0M intangible impairment that didn't recur. Diluted EPS was $1.00 vs $0.48. No new guidance was issued. Cash was $204.1M; long-term debt fell to $591.6M ahead of the $828.7M Facet acquisition, which closed May 4, 2026.

drivers.explanation: Op income and net earnings jumped mainly because Q3 FY2025 absorbed a one-time $62.0M non-cash intangible impairment (bioprocessing, Life Sciences) that did not recur this quarter.

Growth came from Mobile Solutions (+8.1%, Aftermarket demand) and Life Sciences (+12.7%, Food & Beverage and Disk Drive), plus $25.4M favorable FX; Industrial Solutions dipped 0.6% on Aerospace & Defense supply-chain constraints and project timing.

Gross profit rose on higher volume, but margin fell to 33.5% from 34.2% on $9.1M of costs tied to relocating Power Generation production to a new site, partly offset by pricing gains and favorable mix.

Net earnings more than doubled, driven by the absence of last year's $62.0M impairment charge and higher operating income, partially offset by higher interest expense from a higher average debt level.
